articles.title: About 49,000 migrants enter Spanish enclave of Ceuta, officials say
articles.description: This comes after thousands of migrants were reported to have illegally crossed into the territory on Thursday and Friday.

articles.title: Asian nations join growing opposition to Fifa's controversial World Cup investment plan
articles.description: The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) says it "stands in solidarity" with Uefa and Concacaf in opposition to Fifa's proposal to sell stakes in its competitions to private investors.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude AI escapes tests to hack three organisations
articles.description: It comes just days after rival OpenAI said rogue AI agents had breached other firms' networks.

articles.title: Satellite images show impact of heatwaves and drought on UK landscape
articles.description: BBC Verify's analysis indicates “vegetation stress” in many areas, which may affect wildlife and farming.
